resources.string: Next card at your next unlock
Lock your phone to review it: the card is only shown while the phone is locked.
Review several cards in a row
Off: one card each time you unlock your phone, as a small habit. The next card comes at your next unlock.
On: after each answer, the next card is shown right away.
No card in the notification yet. Select your decks, then tap Start reviewing.
Bravo! You\'ve finished all cards in the selected decks.
New cards will show up here when it\'s time to study.
Open AnkiDroid Companion and tap Start reviewing
Cards come from the first deck below that has one to review, then the next one. A deck includes its subdecks. Cards with sound in the question are skipped.
Tick decks in the list below to review them.
Show the current card on your lock screen. Your home screen wallpaper is not changed.
Either AnkiDroid is not installed, or its API is disabled. Enable it in AnkiDroid: Settings › Advanced › Enable AnkiDroid API.
AnkiDroid Companion needs access to your AnkiDroid cards to show them.
Notifications are disabled: cards can\'t be reviewed from the notification. Enable them in the app\'s system settings.
Permission to read AnkiDroid cards was not granted.
Needed to review cards from the notification.
Show cards on the lock screen
Set the AnkiDroid Companion card as your lock screen wallpaper. It is also needed to show the card only while the phone is locked, one card per unlock; without it, the notification stays visible.
Recommended: exclude the app from battery optimization, so new cards show up on time.
Answer hidden on the lock screen? Allow sensitive notifications in your phone\'s notification settings.
The current card, with its answer and the review buttons. Shown on the lock screen.
Shows the card to review on the lock screen.

In the wallpaper settings:

1. Select the Lock screen preview (not Home screen).
2. Open the wallpaper list, choose Live wallpapers, then AnkiDroid Companion card.
3. When asked where to apply it, choose Lock screen only.

Your home screen wallpaper stays unchanged.

On this Android version, a live wallpaper is applied to both the home and the lock screen. The card is only shown while the phone is locked; the home screen will show a plain dark background.\n\nIn the wallpaper settings, open Live wallpapers and choose AnkiDroid Companion card.
